name: @maestro/message-bridge
description: Loopback HTTP direct-send callback endpoint for the maestro bridge: POST /callback on 127.0.0.1 (port published to bridge/http.port, holder signature in bridge/http.port.sig) driving agent turns via followup/inject, with (from,body) 60s idempotency (208), 400 validation and 404 on explicit-to route miss (v1.3 ADDR-R1: no fallback absorption)
